channel.title: PNG: The Road to Independence
channel.desc: PREMIERE: Chronicles one of the most peaceful and improbable transitions to nationhood in modern history. In 1975, Papua New Guinea, home to over 840 languages and hundreds of distinct tribes, defied predictions of chaos to become an independent nation. This film reveals how visionary leaders forged unity from extraordinary diversity.
